title: Microsoft plans to invest more than $10B through 2030 in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, and the UAE, including a $7.9B UAE investment it announced last year (Mark Bergen/Bloomberg)
summary: Mark Bergen / Bloomberg: Microsoft plans to invest more than $10B through 2030 in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, and the UAE, including a $7.9B UAE investment it announced last year — Microsoft Corp. pledged about $2 billion in additional spending in the Middle East, providing the first significant update on its business …
